name: Gigneo – Freelance Marketplace, Job Board & Service Platform
author: deveasel

sections.description:
Gigneo turns your WordPress site into a platform where people can find, hire and pay for services, without writing code.

Use it in one of two ways:

  • Run a marketplace. Freelancers, local pros or agencies list their services, clients hire them, and you earn a commission on every order. Think of a freelance marketplace, a home services platform, a tutoring site or a directory of lawyers.
  • Sell your own services online. If you run a service business, such as a roofing company, cleaning firm, design studio or consultancy, your clients can browse your services, order and pay online, and message your team, all on your own site.

Try the demo | Documentation | Gigneo Pro

What you can build

  • Freelance marketplace
  • Local and home services marketplace: plumbers, electricians, cleaners, roofers
  • Professional services directory: lawyers, accountants, consultants
  • Tutoring and education marketplace
  • Job board for freelance, contract and project work, with proposals, hiring and payments. Not built for salaried recruitment.
  • Online booking and ordering site for your own service business

How marketplace owners earn

  • Commission on every order. Set your platform fee; it’s taken automatically when an order completes. Available in the free plugin.
  • Credits for proposals. Freelancers buy credit packs or get monthly credits to apply to jobs.
  • Commission tiers. Charge different rates by order size.
  • Withdrawal fees. Charge a fee you set when sellers withdraw their earnings.

Free features

Service listings

Sellers create services with packages, prices, delivery times, revisions, FAQs and image galleries. Buyers compare services and order in a few clicks.

Jobs and proposals

Clients post jobs, freelancers send proposals, and the client hires the best fit.

Orders and delivery

Track every order from start to delivery, with revisions, attachments and status updates.

Payments with WooCommerce

Checkout runs on WooCommerce, so you can use the payment gateways you already trust.

Wallet, earnings and withdrawals

Sellers see their balance, earnings and transaction history and request withdrawals. You approve payouts from the admin.

Messaging

Buyers and sellers talk inside each order, with file attachments and email alerts for unread messages.

Reviews and ratings

Buyers review completed orders, which builds trust across your platform.

Frontend dashboards

Freelancers, employers and buyers manage services, jobs, orders, wallets, messages and settings without seeing the WordPress admin.

Public profiles

Freelancer and company profiles show skills, portfolio, ratings and reviews.

Elementor widgets

Design marketplace pages with Elementor widgets for service, job and freelancer grids, carousels and search.

Free modules

Switch Role, Social Profiles, Email Verification, Elementor, Account Deactivation and Account Closure.

Gigneo Pro

Gigneo Pro adds 40+ modules for growing platforms. Turn on only the ones you need:

  • Earn more: Commission Tiers, Withdrawal Fee, Credit Plans, Monthly Credits, Custom Payouts, Analytics
  • Sell in more ways: Hourly, Availability, Custom Offer, Custom Addons, Additional Work, Bonus, Extend Delivery, Intake Form
  • Local services: Maps, Multi Locations, Timezone
  • Trust and safety: Identity Verification, License Verification, Disputes, Report Abuse, Block, Badges, Profile Health
  • Engagement: Live Chat, Real-Time notifications, Following, Vacation Mode, Support, Social Auth
  • Build and integrate: Layout Builder, Dynamic Tags, Bulk Assign, REST API for headless and mobile apps

Need it live fast? The Gigneo Launch Pack sets up your platform for you in 14 days.

Why Gigneo

  • Self-hosted. Your data, your design, your domain. No monthly platform fees or transaction limits from us.
  • Works with your theme. Gigneo is a plugin, not a theme. Use it with Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress or your own theme.
  • Modular. Turn on only the features your platform needs, so it stays fast.
  • Developer friendly. Hooks, filters, templates and documentation for custom builds.

External services

Google Fonts

Used to load custom typography fonts selected in the Gigneo appearance settings.
Opt-in: Disabled by default. The site administrator must enable “Load Google Fonts” under Appearance → Gigneo → General → Appearance before any Google Fonts request is made.
Data sent: Font family name is included in the request URL (e.g., ?family=DM+Sans). No personal user data is transmitted by the plugin. The visitor’s browser may still send standard HTTP request metadata (such as IP address) to Google.
When: Only on the Gigneo user dashboard when (1) Load Google Fonts is enabled and (2) a non-default primary or secondary font is selected. Frontend pages do not load stylesheets from fonts.googleapis.com.
Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq/privacy
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or later
  • PHP 8.0 or later (8.3 recommended)
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or later
  • 128 MB PHP memory or more recommended

Install

  1. In your dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Gigneo”, then click Install and Activate. Gigneo needs WooCommerce, and WordPress will prompt you to install it if it’s missing.
  2. Go to Appearance → Gigneo to set up your platform.
  3. Create your first service or job.

Full setup guide: Getting started.
sections.faq:
What is Gigneo?

Gigneo is a plugin that turns a WordPress site into a service marketplace, freelance platform or job board. You can also use it to sell your own business’s services online.

Can I earn commission with the free version?

Yes. You can take a commission on every order in the free plugin. Gigneo Pro adds commission tiers, withdrawal fees and paid credits for proposals.

I run a service business, not a marketplace. Can I use Gigneo?

Yes. List your own services, let clients order and pay online, and talk to them inside each order. Payments go straight to you as the site owner.

What kinds of platforms can I build?

Freelance marketplaces, local and home services platforms, professional directories, tutoring sites, job boards and niche marketplaces for any industry.

Can I use Gigneo as a recruitment job board?

Gigneo’s job board is built for freelance, contract and project work: employers post jobs, freelancers send proposals, and the hire, payment and delivery happen on your site. It doesn’t include salary fields, employment types, job alerts or links to outside application pages, so it isn’t designed for salaried recruitment.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Gigneo uses WooCommerce for checkout and payments, so you can use any WooCommerce payment gateway.

Does it work with Elementor and my theme?

Yes. Gigneo includes Elementor widgets and works with most themes, including Hello Elementor and Astra.

Is there a demo?

Yes. Try it at app.gigneo.com.

Is Gigneo developer friendly?

Yes. It has a modular architecture, hooks and filters, and a REST API in Pro for headless and mobile apps.

Where can I get help?

Read the documentation or open a topic in the support forum here on WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 – 2026-11-05

  • New: Multi Hire module support. Employers can set open positions on a job and hire several freelancers, each with their own order and payment. Fixed budgets show as “per hire”, and the employer can reopen or complete the job after a hire is cancelled.
  • New: “AI Access (MCP)” module entry (needs Gigneo Pro and the Rest APIs module).
  • New: profile visibility “Private” now hides the profile from signed-out visitors and search engines.
  • New: employer profile access “Private” also applies to employer search, archives, widgets and the search bar.
  • Security: hardening across sign-in and registration, account states, orders, payments, the wallet, withdrawals, messages, file storage and listing visibility. Updating is strongly recommended.
  • Files: private files (licences, order, proposal, chat, dispute and support files) are now served through secure links. On Nginx, add the rule shown in the admin notice after updating.
  • Accounts: blocked and closed accounts are handled the same everywhere; a deactivated account can sign in and reactivate.
  • Orders and payments: stricter checks on order actions, amounts, refunds, top-ups and withdrawals.
  • Services and jobs: paused and rejected listings are only visible to their owner, admins and people with an order or proposal on them. A job with orders in progress can’t be deleted or moved to draft.
  • Email verification: changing the account email requires verifying the new address.
  • Media library: users see only their own uploads.
  • Fix: a job no longer stays “disputed” after its dispute is resolved.
  • Fix: the search bar widget shows the right tabs on services-only and jobs-only sites.
  • Developers: new helpers and filters for account state, amounts, private files and multi hire.

0.1.4 – 2026-10-30

  • New: email notifications for unread order messages. When a message stays unread, the offline receiver gets an email after a delay you set in Theme Options › Notifications.
  • New: order messages can include file attachments, stored per order.
  • Orders, wallet and credits: state changes take a lock, so double clicks and parallel requests can’t double-charge or double-deliver; orders can only be delivered while active, and a revision only on a delivered order.
  • Wallet: deposit minimum and maximum (filterable); deposits are charged exactly and credited to the profile that started them; withdrawals no longer subtract pending withdrawals twice.
  • Payout methods: each saved method keeps its own ID, so adding a method no longer reorders or overwrites the others.
  • Services: with manual approval on, editing a live service (or republishing one moved to draft) sends it back to review; a paused service resumes without review; a service with orders in progress can’t be deleted; a duplicated service starts with zero completed orders so it shows in sorted listings.
  • Jobs: a hired, completed or blocked job can no longer be published again by its author; finishing the edit wizard on a live job, or one already in review, no longer shows an error.
  • Accounts: closed accounts can’t sign in; an account with money or work in progress can’t be closed; login, forgot-password and sign-up are rate limited (per account and per IP, including behind a proxy or CDN); registration follows the “Disable registration” and role-choice settings.
  • Email verification: requesting a new link no longer un-verifies an address that is already verified.
  • Reviews: scores are checked against the allowed range.
  • Profiles: “Last activity” is hidden for accounts with no activity yet and is saved at most once a minute.
  • Countries and states fall back to WooCommerce’s built-in lists when its data isn’t loaded.
  • Invoices: PDFs only load remote files (such as the logo) from this site; use the gigneo_invoice_allowed_remote_hosts filter to allow a CDN. Only wallet and withdrawal invoices link to a WooCommerce order (fixes wrong links with HPOS).
  • Performance: notifications clear only their own cache instead of the whole object cache.

  • Draft preview access for authors is no longer granted in wp-admin, the REST API or XML-RPC.

  • Required by Gigneo Pro 0.1.4.

0.1.3 – 2026-10-20

  • Added admin options in Theme Options to configure whether location is required for remote services and remote jobs (defaulting to required).
  • Updated frontend dashboard service and job creation forms to dynamically toggle location field requirement classes, labels, and notices.
  • Updated backend service details validation to allow saving and publishing remote services without physical locations when configured as optional.
  • Updated backend job details validation to conditionally require location fields based on remote job type and admin setting.
  • Added dynamic frontend event handling in job creation to toggle required location fields when switching between Remote and Onsite work modes.
  • Fixed single job location view to omit the location block cleanly when no physical address or coordinates exist for a remote job.
  • Fixed Elementor Service Carousel slider initialization when rendered inside tabs, preventing vertical image stretching and undefined method errors.
  • Improved payout method configuration handling and withdrawal flow reliability.
  • Cleaned up deprecated user role references and enhanced data sanitization.

0.1.2 – 2026-10-13

  • Prevented double wallet withdrawals by locking balance checks and including pending payouts in available funds.
  • Added a submission cooldown to stop duplicate proposals and spam.
  • Added checks to verify a job is open and valid before letting employers checkout or hire.
  • Added a reusable function to clean and secure complex nested input data safely.
  • Tightened file upload security, validation, and verification across admin and user dashboards.
  • Improved the setup, design, and settings for the Elementor Job and Service carousel widgets.
  • Fixed saved item lists so bookmarked services, jobs, freelancers, and employers display reliably.
  • Polished sorting dropdowns and corrected spacing around search filters.
  • Made form error alerts match the site’s standard danger color across all pages.
  • Fixed popup alerts so they always show on top of page content without getting hidden.

0.1.1 – 2026-10-01

  • Authors can preview their own pending and draft services, jobs, and profiles.
  • Order attachments support filtering and pagination in the dashboard and admin.
  • Profile badge display uses a shared render hook across archive cards, Elementor widgets, orders, and proposals so empty badge sections stay hidden.
  • Order overview loads hourly hire notes only when the Hourly module is active.
  • Long proposal attachment filenames wrap more reliably.
  • Admin post-meta field layout and padding refinements.

0.1.0 – 2026-09-30

  • Added catalog support for the Hourly, Badges, Bonus, Custom Offer, and License Verification Pro modules.
  • Clear Data can remove hourly logs, custom offers, and badge terms when those modules are active.
  • Wallet, earnings, and spending overviews now include bonus invoices.
  • Profile licenses show verification status and rejection reasons when License Verification is active; jobs and proposals surface required licenses.
  • Freelancer and employer archives can filter by badges; badges display on profile and listing cards.
  • Service and job pricing include hourly hire support hooks; service pricing exposes hourly and custom-offer CTA actions.
  • Dashboard supports a Custom Offer section route for the Pro module.
  • Added accepted and declined offer statuses with matching labels and icons.
  • Bookmark buttons show dynamic save and unsave tooltips.
  • Deactivated, closed, and blocked accounts can no longer change account settings; only self-deactivated accounts may reactivate.
  • Clearer order validation when a pricing plan is missing, and improved order success toast timing.
  • Proposal shortlist buttons show an active state when shortlisted.
  • UI refinements across badges, hire forms, dashboard layout, and archive spacing.

0.0.9 – 2026-09-15

  • Added an admin Clear Data tool to remove marketplace data by type, including profiles, listings, orders, and related records.
  • Wallet, earnings, and spending overviews now include additional-work invoices, and credit purchases count toward total spending.
  • Order lists now show delivery status, with stricter delivery validation and clearer deliver-button states.
  • Guests must log in before submitting a service order.
  • Added catalog support for the Following, Analytics, Additional Work, Availability, and Rest APIs Pro modules.
  • Improved Elementor job grid, job carousel, service carousel, and search bar widgets.
  • Select2 dropdowns now display correctly on iPhone and Safari.
  • Profile skill, language, and license sections stay empty-safe after demo data is cleared.
  • Fixed platform invoice status handling.
  • UI refinements across employer cards, order delivery, wallet, and dashboard settings.

0.0.8 – 2026-08-28

  • Improved Freelancer Carousel Elementor pagination bullet controls and styling options.
  • Standardized empty state descriptions across dashboard, hire, and profile screens.
  • Improved dashboard logo sizing and object-fit handling in the top menu.
  • Fixed dark mode notification icon background styling in the dashboard.
  • Improved dashboard layout-2 content wrapper spacing.
  • Frontend AJAX errors now show a clearer fallback message when the server response is missing.
  • Alert dialogs now inherit the primary theme font.
  • Translation file updates.

0.0.7 – 2026-08-27

  • Added Docs & FAQs link to the plugin row meta on the Plugins screen.
  • Improved Elementor service, job, freelancer, and employer carousel pagination bullet controls.
  • Added Search Bar widget control for button icon position.
  • Fixed Hello Elementor theme compatibility detection when matching the active or parent theme name.
  • Fixed job card avatar border-radius so images inherit the avatar radius styles.
  • Removed restrictive single job and service editor content font styles so theme typography applies cleanly.
  • Improved saved listing icon visibility and spending overview chart bar styling.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

0.0.6 – 2026-08-17

  • Improved Elementor job and service grid widgets, including min-height controls and filter layout.
  • Improved Elementor service, job, freelancer, and employer carousel widget styling and controls.
  • Auth login and register buttons now hide when button text is empty, with matching icon field conditions.
  • Theme compatibility now supports child themes of Hello Elementor, Astra, and Eronex.
  • Fixed proposal and order attachment URLs to use path-based upload helpers.
  • Fixed service FAQ removal and allowed paragraph markup in the service description editor.
  • Fixed service saves no longer resetting completed order counts.
  • Dashboard chart and localized colors now follow theme primary color filters.
  • Dark mode and dashboard style refinements.

0.0.5 – 2026-08-06

  • Added service, job, freelancer, and employer carousel widgets for elementor.
  • Improved Elementor job and service grid widgets, including category filter.
  • Added customizable login and register button icons in auth menu settings.
  • Added filters for post type singular/plural labels, slugs, and theme color/font defaults for easier theme integrations.
  • Updated theme compatibility to support Eronex.
  • Fixed theme template override path resolution so child/parent theme gigneo/ overrides load correctly.
  • Fixed Carbon Fields PHP deprecation notices in the bundled dependency container.
  • Improved dashboard job and service edit screens, payout methods UI, and dashboard logo image sizing.
  • UI and style refinements across Elementor widgets, frontend, and dashboard assets.

0.0.4 – 2026-07-29

  • Improved hire/checkout empty states with clearer messages for invalid requests.
  • Fixed proposal overview using the correct freelancer profile meta key.
  • Remove session location lookup (IPAPI).
  • Simplified TinyMCE editor setup across dashboard job, service, order, and settings screens.
  • UI and style refinements across admin, dashboard, and frontend assets.
  • WordPress coding standards improvements and general bug fixes.

0.0.3 – 2026-07-23

  • Improved archive filters and Elementor archive widgets for services, jobs, freelancers, and employers.
  • Enhanced order management UI, including attachments, overviews, and delivery details in admin and dashboard views.
  • Continued RTL refinements across frontend and dashboard styles.
  • Updated notifications, invoices, and related helper logic for more reliable marketplace workflows.
  • UI and style fixes across admin, dashboard, and frontend templates.
  • Code quality improvements, settings updates, and general bug fixes.

0.0.2 – 2026-07-21

  • Added RTL (Right-to-Left) language support across frontend templates and the user dashboard.
  • Improved responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and smaller screen sizes.
  • Security enhancements for AJAX requests, form submissions, and data validation.
  • General bug fixes, stability improvements, and performance optimizations.

0.0.1 – 2026-07-10

  • Initial release.
